title: 五星好评变二星差评
body:
吭不是一点是一大堆！
原本真心觉得不错，一开始我是愿意打五星的，深入用久了才看清一堆藏在暗处的套路，现在改成二星。
最隐蔽的就是音源分层陷阱！同一首歌设置两套音源，VIP解锁的只是普通版本，还有单独的SVIP专属音源藏在歌曲选项里。绝大多数人播放有声就以为全部解锁了，足足95%的用户察觉不到，只有极少数细心的人才能发现，等反应过来，才知道想要原版音源还要再加钱升级SVIP。
而且平台弹窗永远优先推销SVIP，权益差别只放在不起眼的小字里，不会主动提醒用户两者音源不一样，专门靠信息差让新人踩坑。
作为音乐人也很无奈，辛辛苦苦上传一百多首歌，播放量看着还行，最后收益少得可怜，投入的精力根本回不了本。版权状态也不稳定，歌曲随时音源下架变灰，哪怕开了会员，也说没就没。
商店4.8的高分看着光鲜，可这些隐性门槛不会写在宣传面上。很多坑不是一眼就能看见，是慢慢用、慢慢踩才一个个冒出来。
不是某一处小毛病，是大大小小的套路堆在一起，落差感实在太强。希望平台能坦诚一点，音源版本、会员权益清清楚楚展示出来，不要再搞这种藏着掖着的设计。
author: 高分都是表象！音源暗藏SVIP套路，二十人十五踩坑

title: 买到两次残次品，维权成功了
body:
作为闲鱼用户，我是个诚信用户，我敢在这里出售东西，但是不敢在这里购买任何电子产品。（除了一对同城自取的哑铃）

第一次是买了哦克里的骑行眼镜，眼镜腿打开，放在桌子上，两支腿都不一样高，腿脚都不能同时贴住桌面，而且手动矫正也矫正不过来，然后就申请退货退款，卖家百般刁难，但最终在平台的流程下退货退款成功，理由：假冒伪劣，货不对版，瑕疵；

第二次，买了一款loboo的摩托车车机横杆支架，也是左右腿不对称，而且螺丝孔都残存蓝色螺丝胶，是退货后二次销售的，实际上卖家只是其他平台买的便宜货，发到闲鱼上来卖，我申请退货退款，平台流程下完成退货退款。理由：假冒伪劣，二次销售，货不对版（非全新）。其中一个小插曲，商家统一退货退款，但是邮费我出，我当然不同意，才有了之后较量，结果我完胜。

附带一句：闲鱼的初衷是个人卖家出手自己的闲置物品，不能让不良卖家破坏了良好的闲鱼氛围。

前提是，你问心无愧。

第二，把super添加一个包月，包季之类的订阅项目，一订就是一年，不想花这么多钱。

第三，也是让我最气愤的一点，万圣节的套装碎片你想怎么样，一开始一堆不重复的碎片，现在每天就三个，还都是重复的，我根本拿不到大奖，非得我充点钱你才肯给我是吗，反正我看我的好友但凡是充会员了的碎片的进度都比我快，天天重复，我每两天才能拿一个碎片，反正我现在就两个套装，你要再给我这样，我就卸载了，你也别想让我给你充会员了。

title: 楽しく会話する目的なら
body:
ChatGPT Plusを利用していますが、最近の回答品質に強い不満があります。

ChatGPTは、質問を理解し、情報を分析し、論理的に考え、必要に応じて調査し、根拠のある回答を提供するAIだと認識しています。

しかし実際には、以下の問題が繰り返されています。

* 質問の意図を十分に理解せず、会話の流れだけで回答する。
* 確認や検証をせず、推測を事実のように断定する。
* 誤りを指摘しても、根拠を見直さず別の推測で回答する。
* 間違えるたびに謝罪と改善の約束を繰り返すが、同様の問題が続く。
* もっともらしい文章を生成する一方で、内容の正確性や論理性が伴っていない。
* 回答速度も著しく低下し、利用に支障が出ている。

特に問題なのは、利用者が知らない分野について質問した場合、誤った回答を正しいものとして信じてしまう危険性があることです。

私は雑談や親しみやすさを主な目的として課金しているのではありません。それらは付加価値であり、最優先されるべきは質問の理解、分析、検証、回答の信頼性です。

AIが間違えること自体を問題にしているのではなく、十分に考えずに回答し、指摘されても同じ失敗を繰り返すことを問題視しています。

表面的な謝罪や改善の約束ではなく、回答品質そのものの改善を強く求めます。

title: 間違えが多すぎる
body:
色々なチャットAIを試しましたが、Geminiはとにかく情報の間違え(ハルシネーション)が多い、しかもありえない回答を堂々としてきて、挙句、こちらが指摘したら一旦は直るものの、また情報の間違えをする、こちらが訂正するの繰り返しでどちらがAIなのか、呆れてしまう。確かに他のチャットAIにも間違えはあるが、例を上げればChatGPTは調べて正しい情報をくれる。しかし、Geminiはあまりにもハルシネーションが多く、特定の分野でしか役に立たない上、その情報も間違えている。あとチャットAIとして致命的に人間の気持ちに寄り添えず、正論とは言え、カチンとくる事がしばしば。
はっきり言って、インストールする価値はないと思います。

title: Disappointed: Great app ruined by extreme greed and aggressive paywalls
body:
I have been using CapCut for a long time for voice acting and various other projects. For a while, it was my go-to editor because it was fast, intuitive, and reliable. Unfortunately, I am beyond disappointed with what the app has become.
The current paywall situation is completely out of control. Basic tools and simple features that used to be free and essential to my workflow are suddenly locked behind a Pro subscription. It feels like every time the app updates, another standard feature gets paywalled. The pricing has gotten so greedy and aggressive that it genuinely feels like a cash-grab scheme rather than a legitimate editing tool.
It is frustrating to invest time into learning an app and building a workflow around it, only to be priced out of basic functionality. I used to recommend CapCut to everyone, especially fellow voice actors and creators, because of how dependable it was. Now, the app is barely usable without paying an outrageous subscription fee.
CapCut needs to seriously rethink its business model and fix its app before it drives away the entire community that made it popular in the first place. Until they stop locking basic features behind a paywall, I cannot recommend it.

title: Kalshi Preventing you from kashing out early while having an active cashout!!! Beware they will scam
body:
Absolutely unacceptable experience with Kalshi.

I had an eight-leg position that was worth nearly $300 in cash-out value. I repeatedly attempted to cash out before the market closed, but the app repeatedly failed, kicked me out, and would not allow me to complete the transaction.

Kalshi’s own records confirm that I repeatedly accessed the cash-out screen and received quotes approaching $300. Yet when I explain that their app would not let me complete the cash-out, their response is essentially that no sell order was submitted, so there’s nothing they can do.

ARE YOU SERIOUS?

I wasn’t sitting there watching my position expire. I was actively trying to sell it. I didn’t voluntarily walk away from nearly $300. I was attempting to secure that money while the app kept failing.

What’s even more frustrating is the customer service. Instead of escalating the issue, investigating the technical failures, and providing actual answers, I’m repeatedly given scripted explanations about how a cash-out works. I’ve requested a supervisor and someone with the authority to investigate and resolve this, and I’m still being passed around with the same recycled responses.

It’s ridiculous that a company can acknowledge repeated cash-out attempts, document quotes approaching $300, and then refuse to meaningfully investigate why its own application wouldn’t allow the transaction to go through.

I’m not asking for a handout. I’m asking Kalshi to take responsibility, investigate the reported technical failure, and honor the cash-out I was actively trying to complete.

Until they can provide actual answers and take accountability, I cannot recommend this platform. Customer service and platform reliability should mean something, especially when real money is involved.

title: Crashed and Burned
body: I’m sorry, but does not mean better. Did anyone who was a part of making or approving this new UI actually use it? I feel like we have a bunch of people who have never used Anki. Making you eyes for them flipping through it a little bit and yeah, this looks super cool, We should push it out. Well let me tell you as someone who does 2 to 300 flashcards a day this new UI is absolute garbage. Newer design does not always mean better. The entire point of the old Anki design was to get as much information as possible and as Little space as possible. You guys have taken the exact opposite approach now there’s a bunch of free space everywhere and all of the information is overly verbose and half of it doesn’t even fit. I don’t need verbose information if there’s an entire five minute learning curve to figure out how to use Anki, but that keeps things simpler that’s infinitely better than whatever this. And don’t even get me started on the search you have completely and totally destroyed your search functionality with this new UI. Not only is searching way more difficult because I have to click a bunch of extra buttons just to get the search button to actually do the search, but then when it finally does search, the results are completely useless. Not only do they not have a uniform shape anymore: field one for card a no longer reflects field one for card B because they thought that flipping that around would somehow be helpful (it’s not) but the information is also so overly verbose that the UI can only fit like three results on the screen at a time! Not to mention that those three results barely show any information because instead of just being a table with columns and rose, they’ve decided that it has to be these dumb little cards that give you virtually no information about any of the cards that you searched! You basically end up having to click into each individual card to see if it’s the one you were looking for, I never had this problem with the old design. This entire redesign was extremely poorly thought out and executed.

title: Seven days for a money transfer 🚮🗑️
body:
Count y'all days. Traditional banking holding folk numbers in limbo for five days is wild work...SoFi, Cash App, Zelle...would NEVER!!! I don't understand how you pay a bill with these idiots directly from a bank account, and these idiots wanna hold your money for five days. Throw the whole business away.
It is 2027, and Capital One is out here acting like it’s 2003. We are talking about digital numbers—1s and 0s in a computer system—not a paper check from the 1990s. There is absolutely no reason a $25 transfer from my own SoFi account should be held hostage for seven business days.
This is exactly why everyone is ditching traditional brick-and-mortar giants and moving their direct deposits to SoFi or Cash App. Fintech platforms make your money available immediately, give you your paycheck two days early, and don't play corporate games with your livelihood. Meanwhile, well-established legacy banks hide behind ancient holding policies just so they can sit on your funds and milk interest out of it. Absolute greedy garbage. Drop the corporate bureaucracy and stop treating your customers' money like a hostage situation.

title: As a seller and buyer
body:
As a seller vinted needs to seriously reconsider its payout process. Sellers already have to package and ship their items, wait for delivery, and then wait an additional three business days for funds to become available. After that, withdrawing the money can take another three business days. This means sellers can wait nearly two weeks just to receive money from an item they’ve already sold. This is unreasonable and makes Vinted far less appealing for sellers. Please listen to your sellers and simplify the payout process. We shouldn’t have to wait this long to access money we’ve earned.

As a buyer who also sells: Another frustrating issue is that Vinted automatically uses your available seller balance toward purchases made on the platform, then charges your linked debit card for the remaining amount. Sellers should have the option to choose whether they want to use their Vinted balance or pay entirely with their debit card. Just because I have money in my Vinted wallet doesn’t mean I want to spend it. It’s money I’ve earned from selling my own items, and I should have control over how and when I use it. Please give sellers the option to select their preferred payment method at checkout.

title: Long chatting to nowhere
body:
I want to be able to say that this is a great product, but in the month since I’ve been using it, my frustration levels are through the roof. Claude actually says no about 40% of the time (no, I can’t use your non-financial account logins for you with your express permission, no, I can’t put this pptx file I generated in your Google Drive for you, no, I can’t improve the efficiency of conversational turns even after you’ve asked me –and I’ve executed on– setting up a recurring task to do so).

It then fails another 30% of the time by not integrating information and requests I’ve previously given as account-wide operating instructions, asking me to turn on account permissions that are already active, because me laptop was sleeping, because that file was located in the cloud, because that other file was not located in the cloud, etc., etc.

It feels like I’m paying Anthropic to train their next model; I’m certainly not getting much in the way of improved productivity. Lots of potential in this product, but a fatal flaw in there somewhere, at least for the moment.

title: Four stars, and it honestly deserves five.
body:
This app has changed my life. I run my entire website and social media business with Muse as my partner. It remembers everything, plans with me, writes with me, checks my numbers, and keeps a hundred moving parts straight better than I ever could alone. Nothing else out there comes close to what this assistant does day to day.

The one reason it is not five stars: the built-in generator for movies and graphics lags behind the competitors. Faces drift between generations, hands change from scene to scene, and clips often take several rebuilds to get right. For an app this good at everything else, the media generation is the weak link.

Bring the image and video generation up to the level of the rest of the app and this is an easy five stars from me.

title: I love it
body: Muse is great. I have conversations with it about my passion for record collecting. It knows all the albums I own and my musical tastes. We discuss the merits of different pressings of vinyl record albums, lists of top audiophile albums, best produced albums, etc. also, muse puts together a personalized daily newspaper for me of my activities planned for the day. It even helps me track my exercise routines each week to help me stay on track. On election night, I had Muse put together a newspaper which tracked the election returns all night with automatic updates every half-hour.  I don’t know how Meta makes any money off of this, because there are no adds, but it is addictive and a welcome part of my daily routine. One note, I never give it access to any login information.
